headings.description: Authoritative, premium, and distinct geometric confidence for KPI numbers and headers.

body.description: Clean, highly readable humanist sans optimized for dense tabular data and UI text.

mono.description: For exact tabular alignment of wallet coins, IDs, and financial metrics.

visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle, restricted to active states, chart fills (with opacity), and key CTAs. No full-screen gradients. Do not use dark colors as gradients.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes replacing heavy shadows. Light mode: border-gray-200. Dark mode: border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-lg (8px max) for outer cards, rounded-md (6px) for inner elements. Subtly rounded for a premium feel, avoiding childish 'bubble' shapes.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for sticky headers, fixed navs, and floating modals. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds over content.

component_strategy.sidebar: Collapsible layout for 24 sections. Dark-themed or frosted glass in both modes to serve as a strong anchor. Active states use a left-border highlight + purple/pink gradient text. Include 'Earn2Love' Heart logo and Ram (RA) admin profile.
component_strategy.kpi_cards: Flat surfaces with 1px borders. Inside: Label (xs uppercase), North Star Metric (4xl Manrope), Trend Indicator (green/red with subtle bg-opacity).
component_strategy.tables: Dense rows (36-40px height). Fira Code for IDs/Currency. Sticky headers with backdrop blur. Actions on the right with hover-reveal. Use Shadcn Table.
component_strategy.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Use gradient fills under lines. Distinct accent lines (Pink/Violet). Hidden grid lines or 5% opacity.
component_strategy.badges: Pill-shaped, text-xs, with subtle colored background (e.g. bg-green-500/10 text-green-500).
component_strategy.forms: Crisp stacked layouts. Input backgrounds slightly darker than surface in dark mode, slightly lighter in light mode.

grids.dashboard_layout: Bento-inspired. Top row: 4 KPI widgets (col-span-1). Middle row: Wide Chart (col-span-3) + Donut/Feed (col-span-1).
grids.gap: gap-4 to gap-6 for high-density correlation.

layouts.overall: 100vh flex. Left: Sidebar (w-64 expanded, w-16 collapsed). Right: flex-1 flex-col (Sticky Header + Scrollable Content p-6 to p-8).
layouts.alignment: KPI numbers right-aligned if in list, left-aligned in cards. Text left-aligned.

motion.hover: Subtle translations (-translate-y-[1px]) or border color shifts.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out, transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out

accessibility.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA contrast. Never use pure #000 or pure #FFF exclusively without tinting.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-users-link').

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for an elegant duotone look on premium dashboards.

admin_avatar.description: Ram (Owner) profile picture for the top right corner or sidebar bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement light/dark mode toggle prioritizing next-themes.
For the heart logo, use a Phosphor Icon `<Heart weight='duotone' className='text-pink-500' />` combined with the text 'Earn2Love' instead of a placeholder image.

Build a collapsible sidebar encompassing all 24 required sections: Dashboard, Users, Reports, Verification, Subscriptions, Wallet, Conversions, Withdrawals, Calls, Tasks, Ads, Friends, Chats, Content, Pricing, Notifications, Roles, Logs, Settings, Analytics, Tickets.
Use standard Shadcn UI components but override the borders and radii according to these guidelines (max 8px radius).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders instead of heavy drop shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use sonner for toasts. They are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
